name: TickerMint API
description:
Daily TCGplayer market prices for about 130,000 Pokemon, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Riftbound, Yu-Gi-Oh and Gundam
products since February 2024: market and low price
per printing per day, all-time highs and lows, movers, set lists, sealed product,
deck costs and base rates. Prices only; card images and catalog data belong to
TCGplayer and the publishers.

**Terms in one line each.** Free: personal use, link back. Paid: commercial use
(from API Pro). Never: mirror or resell our data. Graded prices: a separate
add-on with its own source credit. Full terms:
https://tickermint.cards/developers#terms

Plans are counted in **card lookups**: a Sheets range, a CSV file or a bulk call
counts one per card returned, every other call counts one. Every answer carries
`X-Quota-Limit`, `X-Quota-Remaining` and `X-Quota-Reset`; single-card answers
carry an `attribution` object (`text`, `url`) to show next to the price.

**No key**: try it with no sign-up, 100 lookups a day per IP, the current price
plus 30 days of history, single cards and search. Personal and non-commercial,
with a link back to the TickerMint page the data came from.

**Free key** (log in with your email, `X-API-Key` header or `?key=`): 1,000 lookups
a day, 90 days of history, Google Sheets ranges and CSV files. Personal use, with
a link back where the prices appear (we check public pages weekly).

**Developer ($19/month or $190/year)**: 50,000 lookups a month, full daily history
since February 2024 and the bulk endpoints (`/v1/bulk/day`, `/v1/bulk/history`,
`/v1/bulk/base-rates`; counted per card returned, a whole day of every card is
about 160,000 lookups). Personal and non-commercial use only, link back.

**API Pro ($49/month)**: 250,000 lookups a month and a commercial license to show
the data in your product, with a link back.

**API Business ($249/month)**: 1,500,000 lookups a month plus written retention
and export rights, with a link back.

**API Platform ($599/month)**: 5,000,000 lookups a month, no link back needed, and
use inside products you run for other businesses.

**Enterprise (from $1,500/month)**: custom volume, redistribution rights, graded
data at volume, an uptime commitment and direct support, by agreement:
hello@tickermint.cards

**Graded prices add-on ($149/month or $1,490/year, API Pro and above, 7-day
trial)**: ungraded, grades 1 to 9.5 and PSA, BGS, CGC, SGC, TAG and ACE 10s from
sold listings, with daily history, on the `/v1/graded/*` endpoints (one lookup
per card). Every value carries `attribution` ("Prices from PriceCharting" and a
link), which must stay visible wherever you show it. Start it at
https://tickermint.cards/developers#graded

Every plan may show prices in your product; no plan may copy or mirror the full
catalog or price history as a dataset for redistribution or a competing price
service (Enterprise by agreement). Yearly billing = 2 months free.

Paid plans start with a 7-day free trial (card required) and get 10% grace over
their monthly quota. Until November 9, 2026 calls over a quota still answer, with
a `Warning` header and a `notice`; after that they get HTTP 429 with an upgrade link.
Per-minute limits (120 without a key, 300 with a free key, more on paid plans)
remain as burst protection.

**Archive**: the full daily archive as gzipped CSV, $99 (research and internal
use, 30-day link) or $299 business edition (internal business use, a year of
weekly builds). Plans, terms and keys: https://tickermint.cards/developers


**For coding agents.** Key: `X-API-Key` header, from the env var `TICKERMINT_API_KEY`
(free key with an email login: https://tickermint.cards/developers#keys). Plans as JSON: https://tickermint.cards/pricing.json;
all docs as markdown: https://tickermint.cards/llms-full.txt. Free keys and Developer are for personal and non-commercial use. A store, a paid app or any product a business runs needs API Pro ($49/mo) or above. Show
"Prices: TickerMint" linking `tickermint_url` next to the prices. Errors carry
`error`, `required_plan`, `how_to_fix` and `upgrade_url`; on 429 wait `Retry-After`.
Prices change once a day: cache answers for an hour or more.
